name: Lumut Maritime Terminal 2 (LMT2), Batu Undan, Perak, Malaysia
description: New 396 m long berth. ShibataFenderTeam designed/supplied 36 x SPC 1200 (G1.0) cone fender systems, each with a 2000 x 4320 mm closed-box steel panel, plus 37 T-head bollards rated 80 tonnes. Original tender specified FE leg fenders at 6.5 m spacing; optimised to cone fenders at 12.5 m spacing. Chain assemblies duplex-coated for corrosion protection. Client Lumut Maritime Terminal; contractor MEB Construction Sdn Bhd.
